articles.title: Mysterious glowing UFO hovers silently over Iran in shocking new video
articles.summary: A mysterious craft has been spotted over a city with a population of millions, nearly 50 years to the day after another infamous UFO sighting investigated by the Pentagon.
articles.body:
A mysteriousUFOhovering overIranhas been captured on video, sparking theories that the strangely shaped craft was not made by human hands.
The video was taken on Sunday by a witness on the Azadegan Highway in Tehran around 7.30pm local time.
A man identifying himself as Ali Sedaghati shared the sighting on X, describing a large, crescent-shaped craft completely illuminated with multi-colored lights.
The witness said: 'I really don't know what it is, but it was near the clouds, had special lights, and was hovering in the space without any sound!'
The object appeared to be a single-wing craft, with a small tail section that curved to a sharp point.
Some have suggested that the silent craft was a drone hovering over the Iranian capital, which is still engaged in a months-long military conflict with the US.
Sedaghati said on X that the object was approximately the size of a large plane, claiming 'it wasn't human-made. It was a UFO, I'm sure.'
The witness was only able to record for just over 20 seconds. He added that when he tried to take more video about ten minutes later, the craft had disappeared.
A man in Tehran, Iran has shared clear footage of an alleged UFO flying silently over the country on September 20
Many viewers of the shocking sighting, which has already been viewed more than 5.2 million times as of Monday morning, believed the UFO was an elaborate drone sighting, claiming a real UFO would not have had such colorful lighting.
Others have suggested that the video captured advanced military surveillance equipment, while Iranian authorities have not identified it.
While some are sure the lights were proof of extraterrestrial life, the US government has maintained that there has never been any evidence recovered that proves UFOs or extraterrestrial life exists and has visited Earth.
However, the sighting also came almost on the exact anniversary of another infamous UFO sighting over Tehran 50 years ago.
That encounter, involving a showdown between Iranian military jets and a giant, diamond-shaped craft, was so concerning to the US that the Pentagon investigated what took place over the Middle East.
A Pentagon spokesperson told the Daily Mail they had 'nothing to provide' regarding this incident when asked for comment on whether the US military detected the object or was conducting operations in the area at the time of the UFO sighting.
However, on September 19, 1976, another brightly lit craft the size of a large airplane was seen flying over the city of Tehran, and even 'attacked' a military fighter jet sent to observe it.
Fifty years ago, the Imperial Iranian Air Force, which was an ally of the US at the time, scrambled two F-4 Phantoms after multiple civilians saw a giant diamond-shaped UFO over the city around 1.30am local time.

articles.title_cn: 神秘发光UFO无声悬停伊朗上空 新视频引发震动
articles.summary_cn: 一个神秘飞行器出现在一座拥有数百万人口的城市上空，而这一天恰好与五角大楼调查的另一著名UFO目击事件相隔近50年。
articles.body_cn:
一段视频捕捉到了一个神秘的UFO悬停在伊朗上空，引发了关于这个形状奇特的飞行器并非出自人类之手的种种猜测。

该视频于周日由一名目击者在当地时间晚上7点30分左右拍摄于德黑兰的阿扎德甘高速公路。

一名自称Ali Sedaghati的男子在X平台上分享了这次目击经历，描述了一个巨大的新月形飞行器，通体被多彩灯光照亮。

该目击者表示：“我真的不知道那是什么，但它靠近云层，有特殊的灯光，而且无声地悬停在空中！”

该物体看起来像是一个单翼飞行器，带有一个弯曲成尖端的尾翼部分。

一些人认为这个无声的飞行器是一架悬停在伊朗首都上空的无人机。伊朗目前仍与美国处于持续数月的军事冲突之中。

Sedaghati在X平台上表示，该物体大约有一架大型飞机那么大，并声称“它不是人造的。我确定那是一架UFO。”

该目击者仅录制了20多秒。他补充说，大约十分钟后当他试图拍摄更多视频时，该飞行器已经消失了。

伊朗德黑兰的一名男子分享了9月20日一个疑似UFO无声飞越该国的清晰画面。

截至周一上午，这段令人震惊的目击视频已被观看超过520万次。许多观众认为该UFO是一架精心制作的无人机，称真正的UFO不会有如此多彩的灯光。

其他人则认为视频捕捉到的是先进的军事侦察设备，而伊朗当局尚未对其作出确认。

虽然一些人确信这些灯光是外星生命存在的证据，但美国政府一直坚持认为，从未有任何回收证据能证明UFO或外星生命存在并曾造访地球。

然而，这次目击事件几乎恰好发生在50年前另一起著名的德黑兰UFO目击事件的周年纪念日。

那次遭遇涉及伊朗军方与一个不明飞行物之间的对峙……

articles.title: Department of War Issues New UAP Disclosure Waiver; But Similar Protections Already Existed
articles.summary: The Department of War announced September 14, 2026, that it has issued a targeted legal waiver allowing current and former military personnel, civilian employees and contractors to provide protected information concerning Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) directly to designated representatives of the government’s PURSUE effort. articles.body:
The Department of War announced September 14, 2026, that it has issued a targeted legal waiver allowing current and former military personnel, civilian employees and contractors to provide protected information concerning Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) directly to designated representatives of the government’s PURSUE effort.
According to the Department, the waiver establishes an “authorized, legally protected disclosure mechanism” for individuals possessing UAP-related National Defense Information, or NDI.
“This waiver establishes an authorized, legally protected disclosure mechanism for current and former personnel to provide UAP-related National Defense Information (NDI) to designated representatives of the PURSUE effort,” the Department said.
The announcement is significant, particularly because the Department expressly references Special Access Program Indoctrination Agreements alongside conventional nondisclosure agreements.
But the underlying concept, allowing government personnel to provide otherwise protected UAP information to specifically authorized government investigators without violating their NDAs, is not new.
Documentspreviously obtainedand published by The Black Vault show that similar protections were already established for disclosures to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO). Those protections became a central issue during AARO’sunsuccessful attemptsto interview former intelligence official David Grusch in 2023.
The new announcement therefore raises an important question: What does the PURSUE waiver provide that the government did not already provide through AARO?
The public announcement does not fully answer that question.
According to the Department of War, the new directive covers “all current and former DOW service members, civilian personnel, and contractors holding or previously granted access to UAP-related National Defense Information.”
Those individuals are now authorized to provide that information directly to official PURSUE representatives.
The Department specifically states:
“The waiver supersedes civil and administrative enforcement provisions contained within Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and Special Access Program Indoctrination Agreements (SAPIAs) previously executed within the United States, strictly for communications directed to the PURSUE team.”
That final limitation is important.
The announcement does not provide blanket authorization for personnel to disclose protected information publicly. It does not state that classified information may be provided to journalists or released independently by the individual possessing it. Nor does the announcement itself declassify information.
The authorization described by the Department applies specifically to disclosures made to PURSUE.
According to the Department, information entering that channel would undergo “systematic review, security evaluation, and potential declassification.”

articles.title_cn: 战争部发布新UAP披露豁免令 但类似保护措施早已存在
articles.summary_cn: 战争部于2026年9月14日宣布，已发布一项有针对性的法律豁免令，允许现任和前任军事人员、文职雇员及承包商直接向政府PURSUE计划的指定代表提供有关不明异常现象（UAP）的受保护信息。据该部门称，该豁免令建立了一个“授权……”
articles.body_cn:
战争部于2026年9月14日宣布，已发布一项有针对性的法律豁免令，允许现任和前任军事人员、文职雇员及承包商直接向政府PURSUE计划的指定代表提供有关不明异常现象（UAP）的受保护信息。

据该部门称，该豁免令为持有UAP相关国防信息（NDI）的个人建立了一个“经授权且受法律保护的披露机制”。

“该豁免令为现任和前任人员建立了一个经授权且受法律保护的披露机制，使其能够向PURSUE计划的指定代表提供UAP相关的国防信息（NDI），”该部门表示。

这一宣布意义重大，尤其是因为该部门明确将特别访问计划保密协议与常规保密协议一并提及。

但其基本概念——允许政府人员在不违反保密协议的前提下向特定授权的政府调查人员提供原本受保护的UAP信息——并非新鲜事物。

The Black Vault此前获取并公布的文件显示，针对向全域异常解决办公室（AARO）披露信息的类似保护措施早已建立。这些保护措施在AARO于2023年试图约谈前情报官员David Grusch未果的过程中成为了核心争议问题。

因此，这一新公告提出了一个重要问题：PURSUE豁免令提供了哪些政府此前通过AARO未曾提供的保护？

公开公告并未完全回答这一问题。

据战争部称，新指令涵盖“所有现任和前任战争部服役人员、文职人员及承包商，凡持有或此前被授予访问UAP相关国防信息权限者”。

这些个人现已被授权直接向官方……提供相关信息。

articles.title: What Timothy Gallaudet’s NOAA Emails Reveal About His Interest in UAPs
articles.summary: A newly released Freedom of Information Act response from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration offers a limited but useful look at UAP-related keyword hits found in the email records of Dr. Timothy Gallaudet, the former Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting NOAA [...] The post What Timothy Gall
articles.body:
A newly released Freedom of Information Act response from theNational Oceanic and Atmospheric Administrationoffers a limited but useful look at UAP-related keyword hits found in the email records ofDr. Timothy Gallaudet, the former Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting NOAA Administrator, and Deputy NOAA Administrator.
The request, filed July 10, 2023, sought all emails sent to, from, or copied to Gallaudet between October 25, 2017, and January 20, 2021, that contained a series of UFO- and UAP-related terms. Those terms included “UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL,” “UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS,” “AARO” (included even though AARO pre-dated date range), “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “UNIDENTIFIED FLYING,” “AOIMSG,” “ELIZONDO,” and “GRUSCH.” Those dates were chosen as they coincided with his time at NOAA. A second FOIA request was filed with the Navy, which is still open.
NOAA’s final response, dated May 6, 2026, stated that the agency located 51 responsive records totaling 245 pages. According to the agency, 167 pages were released in full, while 78 pages were released with redactions under FOIA exemption (b)(6), which protects personal privacy. NOAA stated the request was complete.
While the release does not reveal extensive government discussions about UAP programs, it does provide a glimpse into the information ecosystem surrounding the issue and the material that was reaching Gallaudet during his time at NOAA.
Among the more notable records are emails connected to the Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force (UAPTF).
In an August 17, 2020 email, Gallaudet wrote, “I told you that I’m on another Interagency ESC chaired by the chair of this TF – ONI’s CO. I will!” The reference appears to indicate that Gallaudet was serving on a separate interagency Executive Steering Committee (ESC) chaired by the same Office of Naval Intelligence official who was leading the UAP Task Force at the time. While the email does not suggest that Gallaudet himself was a member of the UAPTF, it does show an awareness of the task force and a professional connection to its leadership through another government coordination mechanism. His email stated that he “will” get answers to the UAP issue, given his connections to its top leadership.
During the period in question, the UAP Task Force was at the Office of Naval Intelligence, then led by Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Aeschbach and Gallaudet were not strangers to one another. Both had previously served in senior Navy leadership positions, according to Gallaudet’s email.
While the released records do not indicate that Gallaudet participated in the UAP Task Force itself, his August 2020 email suggests he was clearly familiar with its leadership and had professional access to the same senior official overseeing the effort through a separate interagency Executive Steering Committee (ESC). articles.title_cn: Timothy Gallaudet的NOAA邮件揭示了他对UAP的关注
articles.summary_cn: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局最新公布的信息自由法回复，为了解前商务部海洋与大气助理部长Timothy Gallaudet博士电子邮件记录中与UAP相关的关键词命中情况提供了一个有限但有用的视角。
articles.body_cn:
美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）最新公布的一份信息自由法（FOIA）回复，为了解Timothy Gallaudet博士电子邮件记录中与UAP相关的关键词命中情况提供了一个有限但有用的视角。Gallaudet曾任商务部海洋与大气助理部长、代理商务部海洋与大气副部长、代理NOAA局长及NOAA副局长。

该请求于2023年7月10日提交，要求获取2017年10月25日至2021年1月20日期间发送给Gallaudet、由其发送或抄送给他的所有电子邮件，这些邮件需包含一系列与UFO和UAP相关的术语。这些术语包括“UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL”、“UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS”、“AARO”（尽管AARO的成立时间晚于所请求的日期范围，仍被列入）、“UAP”、“UAPTF”、“UFO”、“UNIDENTIFIED FLYING”、“AOIMSG”、“ELIZONDO”和“GRUSCH”。选择这些日期是因为它们与他在NOAA的任职时间重合。另一份FOIA请求已提交给海军，目前仍在处理中。

NOAA的最终回复日期为2026年5月6日，称该机构找到了51条相关记录，共计245页。据该机构称，其中167页被完整公开，78页根据FOIA豁免条款(b)(6)（保护个人隐私）进行了删减后公开。NOAA表示该请求已完成处理。

虽然此次公开并未揭示政府关于UAP项目的大量讨论，但确实为了解围绕该问题的信息生态以及Gallaudet在NOAA任职期间所接触到的材料提供了一个窗口。

其中较为引人注目的记录与不明空中现象任务小组（UAPTF）有关的电子邮件。

在一封日期为2020年8月17日的电子邮件中，Gallaudet写道：“我告诉过你，我在另一个跨部门ESC中，由这个任务小组的主席——海军情报办公室的指挥官——主持。我会的！”这一提及似乎表明Gallaudet在一个单独的跨部门执行指导委员会（ESC）中任职，该委员会由当时领导UAP任务小组的同一名海军情报办公室官员主持。虽然该邮件……

articles.title: Navy Releases Massive Cache of Scott Bray UAP Emails After Four Years; More Than 300 Pages Withheld in Full
articles.summary: The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort. The records were obtained by The Black Vault [...] The post Navy Releases Massive
articles.body:
The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort.
The records were obtained by The Black Vault through a Freedom of Information Act request filed on May 24, 2022. The request sought emails sent to, from, copied to or blind-copied to Bray containing terms including “Unidentified Aerial Phenomena,” “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “AATIP,” “AAWSAP” and several related phrases.
More than four years later, the Navy responded on September 23, 2026. According to its response, the search located 1,321 pages of responsive records. The Navy withheld 302 pages in their entirety, while releasing the remaining 1,019 pages with redactions under several FOIA exemptions.
Bray served as Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence and Director of the Naval Intelligence Activity during much of the period covered by the records. His position placed him within a network of Navy, Defense Department and Intelligence Community officials dealing with UAP reporting, briefings, congressional interest and the development of what ultimately became the Navy-led Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force.
One email in the release described the relationship directly, stating that John “Jay” Stratton “leads the UAP Task Force effort for Navy… working directly for Scott Bray, our Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence.”
Bray later became one of the government’s most visible officials on the UAP issue. On May 17, 2022, he appeared with Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security Ronald Moultrie before a House Intelligence subcommittee during a public congressional hearing devoted to UAP. The hearing was followed by a classified session.
The newly released records provide a much larger documentary backdrop to that public role.
A Broad Look Behind the Government’s UAP Effort
The correspondence stretches across years and includes exchanges involving Stratton, Defense Intelligence official Neill Tipton, senior Navy officials, admirals, Pentagon public-affairs personnel and other Defense and Intelligence Community officials.
For example, a March 2020 exchange shows Tipton, who was then identified in his signature block as Director of Defense Intelligence, Collection and Special Programs in OUSD(I&S), telling Bray that he had a document “relevant to our discussion the other day” that he preferred to deliver in hard copy. Other correspondence concerning a planned Senate Select Committee on Intelligence briefing includes Bray, Stratton, Tipton and Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Elsewhere, the records show Stratton discussing proposed public language concerning the UAP effort and whether it should be reviewed by Bray before being sent forward. Other email traffic includes Vice Adm. Matthew Kohler, Rear Adm. Charles Brown and Rear Adm.
articles.title_cn: 海军四年后公布Scott Bray大量UAP邮件 逾300页被完整扣留
articles.summary_cn: 美国海军部公布了超过1300页涉及前海军情报局副局长Scott W. Bray的电子邮件及相关记录，为了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期围绕不明空中现象的政府通信打开了一扇广阔的窗口。
articles.body_cn:
美国海军部公布了超过1300页涉及前海军情报局副局长Scott W. Bray的电子邮件及相关记录，为了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期围绕不明空中现象的政府通信打开了一扇广阔的窗口。

The Black Vault通过2022年5月24日提交的信息自由法（FOIA）请求获得了这些记录。该请求要求获取发送给Bray、由其发送、抄送或密送给他的电子邮件，其中包含“Unidentified Aerial Phenomena”、“UAP”、“UAPTF”、“UFO”、“AATIP”、“AAWSAP”及若干相关短语。

四年多后，海军于2026年9月23日作出回复。根据其回复，搜索找到了1321页相关记录。海军将302页完整扣留，其余1019页根据多项FOIA豁免条款进行了删减后公开。

Bray在记录所涵盖的大部分时期内担任海军情报局副局长和海军情报活动主任。他的职位使他处于一个由海军、国防部和情报界官员组成的网络中，负责处理UAP报告、简报、国会关注以及最终发展为海军领导的不明空中现象任务小组的相关工作。

公开记录中的一封电子邮件直接描述了这一关系，称John “Jay” Stratton“领导海军的UAP任务小组工作……直接向我们的海军情报局副局长Scott Bray汇报。”

Bray后来成为政府在UAP问题上最引人注目的官员之一。2022年5月17日，他与国防部情报与安全副部长Ronald Moultrie一起出席了众议院情报小组委员会专门就UAP举行的公开国会听证会。听证会之后还举行了一次机密会议。

新公布的记录为这一公开角色提供了更为庞大的文献背景。

articles.title: What is the Electronic Reading Room?
articles.summary: Welcome to the Central Intelligence Agency's Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room.
articles.summary_cn: 欢迎来到中央情报局信息自由法电子阅览室。
articles.body_cn:
美国中央情报局（CIA）的信息自由法（FOIA）电子阅览室是该机构面向公众开放的重要在线资源平台。该阅览室汇集了依据信息自由法已经解密并向公众公开的大量文件，涵盖情报活动、历史档案、UAP相关记录等多个领域。

电子阅览室的设立旨在提高政府透明度，方便公众、研究人员和记者查阅已解密的历史文件。用户可以通过关键词搜索、日期筛选等方式查找感兴趣的文件。对于UFO/UAP研究领域而言，CIA电子阅览室中收录的与不明飞行物相关的历史档案一直是研究人员和爱好者关注的重要资料来源。

该平台是公众了解政府情报活动历史记录的重要窗口，也是信息自由法制度在情报领域的具体体现。

articles.title_cn: 伊朗上空出现UFO？不明物体悬停德黑兰 亮光视频疯传
articles.summary_cn: 视频据称显示明亮灯光划过德黑兰夜空，引发了对不明物体的种种猜测。帖子声称画面拍摄于9月19日前后，但其位置……
articles.body_cn:
近日，多段视频在社交媒体上广泛传播，据称显示明亮灯光划过伊朗首都德黑兰的夜空，引发了关于不明飞行物的热烈讨论。发布者声称这些画面拍摄于9月19日前后，但视频的具体拍摄地点和真实性尚未得到独立核实。

视频中可以看到多个发光体在夜空中移动，灯光呈现出多种颜色，这一特征引发了不同的解读。部分观众认为这些灯光过于多彩，不太可能是真正的不明飞行物，更可能是无人机或军用照明设备。也有人认为这可能是某种先进的军事侦察装备。

伊朗当局尚未对这些目击报告作出官方确认或解释。与此同时，这一事件恰逢50年前德黑兰著名UFO目击事件的周年纪念日前后，使得公众对伊朗上空不明飞行物的关注度进一步升温。

美国政府一贯表示，从未有任何回收证据能够证明UFO或外星生命存在并曾造访地球。
